user_problem: Supplied testimonial material needs an offline readiness review for attribution, scope, edits, and permission gaps.
unique_output: A readiness table covering exact words, proposed excerpt, attribution terms, claim scope, edit disclosure, and blockers.
required_input: Testimonial text, written permission terms, attribution preference, proposed placement, and intended excerpt.
critical_rule: Do not infer consent, authenticity, or typicality; any permission or scope gap blocks a ready designation.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is case-study-interview-kit; this reviews existing testimonial-use conditions rather than preparing an interview.
acceptance_scenario: Input quote permits website use with company attribution but proposed placement is a brochure and excerpt removes 'for our small team.' Output blocks brochure use and flags the removed scope qualifier.
